list_files.description: The encounter data files CBP currently publishes (read from its Nationwide Encounters document page): one row per CSV with its path for the encounters request. The files are replaced every month.

encounters.description: Nationwide encounters (OFO inadmissibles and Border Patrol apprehensions under Title 8) by fiscal year and month, component, land border region, area of responsibility or state, demographic and citizenship. Use list_files for the current file paths.

file.desc: the file's path under /sites/default/files without .csv, from list_files, e.g. 2026-11/nationwide-encounters-fy24-fy27-oct-aor

region.desc: keep these Land Border Region values: Southwest Land Border, Northern Land Border, Other

component.desc: keep Office of Field Operations or U.S. Border Patrol

fiscal_year.desc: keep these fiscal years as published (2025; the current year is '2027 (FYTD)')

citizenship.desc: keep these citizenships as published (MEXICO, VENEZUELA ...)
